newsitem.title: USA: Vinik lifts Morningstar stake to 7.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vinik lifts Morningstar stake to 7.9 pct.

text.p: A group led by former Magellan Fund manager Jeffrey Vinik said Friday it raised its stake in Morningstar Group Inc to 7.9 percent or 1,208,000 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 82,400 additional shares of Morningstar between December 13 and 31 at prices ranging from $18.6875 to $20.1550 a share.
The group holds its stakein the Dallas-based refrigerated food products manufacturer for investment.
Vinik operates Vinik Asset Management L.P., an investment partnership, and several other partnerships serving as investment vehicles for the group.
